statement: The EU AI Act was formally adopted on March 13, 2024, establishing comprehensive regulations for artificial intelligence systems.
GDPR fines reached €1.6 billion in 2023, with major violations in data processing and consent management.
Federal Reserve maintained interest rates at 5.25-5.50% in January 2024, signaling potential cuts later in the year.
US-China trade tariffs remain at 25% on $250B of goods as of November 2023, with ongoing negotiations.
UK updated employment regulations in February 2024, affecting flexible working rights and redundancy procedures.
India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act was passed in August 2023, with implementation expected in 2024.
SEC enhanced disclosure requirements for climate-related risks in January 2024, affecting public companies.
FTC and DOJ updated merger guidelines in December 2023, increasing scrutiny on vertical and horizontal mergers.
HIPAA enforcement actions increased 40% in 2023, focusing on healthcare data breaches and business associate agreements.
EU expanded sanctions against Russia in February 2024, targeting additional sectors and individuals.
Global supply chain disruptions decreased in Q4 2023, with shipping costs returning to pre-pandemic levels.
New federal cybersecurity requirements for critical infrastructure were announced in January 2024.
EU carbon prices reached €85 per ton in November 2023, driven by policy changes and market demand.
UK-EU data adequacy decision was extended in January 2024, ensuring continued data flows until 2025.
India's manufacturing PMI reached 56.4 in December 2023, indicating strong growth in the sector.
DOJ and FTC increased enforcement actions against tech platforms in early 2024, focusing on competition.
EU Digital Markets Act came into full effect in March 2024, requiring gatekeeper platforms to comply with new rules.
Global inflation rates moderated to 3.2% in January 2024, down from peak levels in 2022-2023.
US unemployment rate remained at 3.7% in February 2024, with strong job growth in services sectors.
China's data localization requirements were strengthened in September 2023, affecting foreign companies operating in China.
